tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ye shes rab 'bar las: bskyed rdzogs chung ngu'i dang po las kyi drag po bzlog pa dang 'brel ba'i phrin las bzhugs so:

e ma nyon cig rigs kyi bu: drag po pad+ma'i sgrub pa la: dben pa'i gnas su mtshams bcad cing: dkyil 'khor sgo gru rgyan rnams rdzogs: dbus su gru gsum bsnol ma bya: sgrub rten bhan+dha mtshan ldan dang: zur mang shel dang me long dang: bum pa mtshan ldan mgul chings dmar: ma nyams rdo rje dril bu dang: thod pa ltag sprod la sogs 'chang: sgrub gtor gru gsum bsnol ba'i thog: dpal gtor zur gsum brjid ldan bsham: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: nga ni dbang drag pad+ma khro bo'i sku: sku las khro chung mtshon cha'i thog ser 'phro: gsang sngags sgrub la blta bar mi dbang kun: byer cig dengs shig rang rang gnas su dengs: hūm̐ hrī: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: sum+bha= gnyis pa lta bas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag ni dbang drag pad+ma he ru ka: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lhar gyur pa'i: phyi rol mtshon cha me ri sdig pa'i gur: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor 'gyur med lhun gyis grub: badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: gsum pa brda sgo phye dang brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bskal pa sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha: gu ru drag po deng 'dir mjal phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i yi dam lha: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon o rgyan rje: pad+ma drag po'i rnam par skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir bdag la byin chen dbab tu gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang mchod rdzas lha mi'i 'dod yon rdzas: bsangs sbyangs kun bzang sprin gyi phung por gyur: ar+ghaṃ sogs shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings kyi bhan+dhar bcud kyi ra sā yan: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: snod kyi thod par rak+ta'i ba gam 'khrigs:

gīrti dmar mos gsang ba'i byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: khor yug snod du gtor chen ri ltar spungs: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ngo bor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud bdag gzhan stong par sbyang: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las tshad med snying rje'i mdangs: dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: shes rig ngo bo hūm̐ yig dmar por bzhengs: badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: skyed byed rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ dmar las: e 'phros chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: yaṃ 'phros 'byung ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng: baṃ 'phros ye shes rak+ta'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: laṃ 'phros rin chen sa gzhi snyoms par brdal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las skam rlon thod pa'i gzhal yas su: 'od dang 'od zer tshang khang 'khrigs pa las: ye shes drag po me ris bskor ba'i dbus: gsang sgrub ltar du bskyed cing: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku pad+ma 'od 'bar skad cig la: rngam brjid khros pa'i hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: sprul pa yang sprul dpag yas 'jigs tshul ston: che mchog dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: dza: chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar skur bzhengs pa: dug gsum 'bar ba'i khro gtum 'jigs gzugs can: dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol:

mdze nad gnyan lhog 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: smyo 'bog brgyal nad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' yi dmag dpung 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mi nad phyugs nad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: gru gsum dmar nag dregs pa'i gdan khri la: drag po dgyes par dgongs la bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba niḥ na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med drag po'i sku: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: pad+ma drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: rigs lnga yab yum bdud rtsi char ltar 'beb: ye shes bdud rtsi gnyis med mnyam sbyor ba: pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: hūm̐: rten 'brel bcu gnyis rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'khrug: gu h+ya mū la rak+ta'i ba gam 'khrigs: gīrti'i rak+ta skar ltar 'khrugs pa 'di: pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: srid gsum ye nas gtor gzhong du: snod bcud thams cad gtor mar sbyar: 'khor 'das yongs sgrol mchod pa'i tshogs: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: stong gsum stong gi gtor gzhong du: ri rab 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsug: skye 'gro sems can grangs las 'das: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha khrag thod tshil spungs: zhag dang rlangs pa chi li li: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan rol mo dang: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang: ma hā bā lin+ta la khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen rang bzhin khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:

pad+ma drag po dmar nag 'bar ba'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: gtum drag 'jigs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar: sde brgyad zil gyis gnon cing gzir bar byed: g.yon pa'i sdig pas lha srin snying khrag 'jib: dmar nag khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa 'dul mdzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: log 'dren 'dul mdzad dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs klu dang dgra bgegs 'dul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag ni drag po sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: khyod kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'gong po 'dul ba'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad bshams nas: bsang sbyang bya ba ni: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi dngos po bsreg cing bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros: 'dod yon zag med bdud rtsis gang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: rgyu yi bcud chen sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ye shes rigs lnga'i bdud rtsi bcud du 'khyil: 'dod yon tshogs dang dbyer med bde ba che: lha rnams dgyes mdzad sngags kyi 'dod yon 'khrigs: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: spyan 'dren pa niḥ hrī: rje btsun pad+ma drag po rtsal: rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor dang: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod pa ni: hrī: bla ma drag po rdo rje phag mo dang: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la tshogs mchod 'bul: bdag gis ma rig thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

'dod yon tshogs mchod 'bul bas bskang zhing bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya: bsgral las ni: bden tshig gis bla srog bkug la: hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma drag po'i sku: rngams drag gtum pa'i rang bzhin las: yak+sha me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum khengs: g.yas pas rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: bskang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bstan dgra bsgral pa'i bam gyi tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi don snying 'di: drag po dgyes pa bskang ba'i phyir: zhal du bstab po kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta ba su ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: lhag ma ni: dang po phud kyis dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod: bar du tshogs kyis 'dus pa rgya mtsho bskang: tha ma lhag la dbang ba 'dir gshegs shig: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong zhing sgrub pa'i grogs: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka 'bar ma yis: bka' yi pha 'bab lhag ma'i longs spyod bzhes: ci bcol phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel zhig: sa ma ya uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta khā hi khā hi: chad mdo ni: hūm̐: bskal pa sngon tshe bar dang tha ma la: kun bzang snang mtha' pad+ma thod phreng gis: bka' gsang gter du sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: bka' srung so sos khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: phrin las sgrubs shig bka' yi srung ma rnams: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: da lta snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul ba'i dus: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdzogs chen rnal 'byor klong gsal snying po la: skad cig 'bral ba med par byin brlabs nas: zhal mjal dbang bskur snyan brgyud bstan pa'i tshe: bka' srung so sos khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: phrin las sgrubs shig bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: brtan skyong ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: rgya bal bod yul gnas rnams su: lha 'drer ma lus dam la btags:

dam la ma 'dus gang yang med: lha 'dres bka' las mi 'da' 'tshal: bka' las ma 'da' dam la 'dus: gang bcol sgrubs shig sa ma ya: mnan pa ni: hūm̐: dug lnga 'dus pa'i lha 'dre mnan: steng du drag po'i bro brdungs pas: lha 'dre bdag tu 'dzin pa bcom: rang grol klong du rgyas 'debs so: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ lam s+t+wam bha ya mā ra ya nan: bkra shis ni: hrī: zhi ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i che btsan che mchog he ru ka: dbyings phyug phag mo mkha' 'gro'i bran dang bcas: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog: hrī: mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi: skye dgus bstod tshe me tog char 'beb pa: rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa'i bkra shis gang: bkra shis des kyang rtag tu bde legs shog: bsnyen bsgrubs dge bas mkha' mnyam skye 'gro yi: 'jigs pa brgyad zhi 'byor pa mang rgyas shing: khams gsum dbang 'du dgra bgegs ming med pas: 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: bsngo ba ni: hrī: bskyed rdzogs 'bras bus legs pa'i dge ba gang: dmigs med mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro la bsngo: byang chub snying po'i sa bon gong 'phel nas: ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig: smon lam ni: hrī: dmigs med 'gro la bsngos pa'i sa bon gang: bskyed dang rdzogs pa chen po'i smin grol gyis: phyam gcig chos dbyings klong du skyel ba yi: nus pas dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: bsdu rim ni: snang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kun: rang grol stong pa'i chos dbyings klong du a: gang shar pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro ba'i dpal du lam khyer lhang nger gsal: rang byung dkyil 'khor gang shar lha tshogs la: tshogs drug mchod 'bul lha mo'i mchod 'bul gyis: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpal la rol: lam khyer drag po'i rnam rol ma yengs par: gzhom gzhig mi mnga' pad+ma drag po bzhin:

kun gyi che btsan 'grub pa e ma ho: de ltar drag po'i bskyed rdzogs yid bzhin snying: phyi rabs rjes 'jug don du dbab pa 'di: gnam chen dal du mkha' 'gros bdag tu 'dzin: mkha' 'gro'i gces nor bu dang 'phrad pa 'byung: zungs shig drag po gsum dang srog bdag gsum: 'gro ba'i zug rngu tsha ba'i dus der spyod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes bde chen gnam chen brag dkar zla gam dbang gi dal nas ye shes mkha' 'gros spyan drangs pa ste/ yid kyi grogs po pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul phyir bde klong rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong gsal snying pos rang bzhin lha'i gzhal med khang du dag par phab pa'o// //
